boards.title: Your First Weekend at Tulane University of Louisiana, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence mixing campus orientation, student programming, recreation, and nearby public culture.

cards.title: Start with a Gibson Quad lap
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Uptown campus
cards.notes: Use the first daylight break to orient yourself around Gibson Quad, then use it as a simple landmark when meeting new classmates later.
cards.short_summary: Establish a campus landmark before plans get busy.
cards.evidence_claim: Tulane’s official virtual tour includes Gibson Quad as a featured Uptown-campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow any posted university access guidance.

cards.title: Meet up on Newcomb Quad
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Uptown campus
cards.notes: Pick Newcomb Quad for an easy daylight meet-up, then continue together to the museum directly facing the quad instead of splitting up.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering point paired with nearby art.
cards.evidence_claim: Tulane’s virtual tour features Newcomb Quad, and Newcomb Art Museum states that it directly faces the quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow any posted university access guidance.

cards.title: See what is on view at Newcomb Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Woldenberg Art Center
cards.notes: Check the exhibition schedule before heading over, and enter “Newcomb Art Museum” in navigation rather than relying on the mailing address.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop directly opposite Newcomb Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Newcomb Art Museum is in the Woldenberg Art Center, faces Newcomb Quad, and lists public visitor hours.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; it closes during the university summer break. Check the visit page before going.

cards.title: Locate Howard-Tilton for the week ahead
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Uptown campus
cards.notes: Walk past Howard-Tilton Memorial Library while campus is quiet, save its location, and identify it as a dependable daytime reset point.
cards.short_summary: Turn a first-weekend walk into a useful academic landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Tulane’s official virtual tour includes Howard-Tilton Memorial Library as a featured campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours can vary; verify current visitor and building-access information before entering.

cards.title: Make dinner plans at The Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Uptown campus
cards.notes: Use The Commons as a straightforward first meal rendezvous, then compare dining options and student-service locations in the same campus hub.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining and student-life anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Tulane identifies The Commons as a focal point for campus life with dining options and student services.
cards.access_notes: Dining purchases may be required; check current dining access and hours before arrival.

cards.title: Choose the Saturday LBC Movie Night
cards.subtitle: Saturday 8 p.m. · The Village Theater
cards.notes: Check the current LBC listing for that week’s film, arrive a little early with your group, and use the screening as an easy shared plan.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Saturday-night campus movie option.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lavin-Bernick Center states that it hosts Saturday movie screenings at 8 p.m. in The Village theater.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Saturday nights at 8 p.m.; confirm the current movie and any attendance requirements on the LBC events listing.

cards.title: Try a Reily recreation session
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · Uptown campus
cards.notes: Bring campus credentials and choose one approachable option—pool, indoor track, or a group class—so the visit stays flexible for new friends.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with several activity formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Tulane says the Reily Student Recreation Center offers swimming, exercise classes, and an indoor track.
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation lists Reily as an Uptown facility; verify current hours, eligibility, and class availability before going.

cards.title: Walk Audubon Park’s jogging path
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · Uptown New Orleans
cards.notes: Start from the St. Charles Avenue side and take a relaxed section of the 1.8-mile path; bring water and stay with your group.
cards.short_summary: A public Uptown park with a documented walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: Audubon Park is open to the public and includes a 1.8-mile jogging path; its listed hours are daily from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The park lists daily hours of 5 a.m.–10 p.m. Review park rules and use normal nighttime precautions.

cards.entity_name: Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Take an art walk at Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · City Park
cards.notes: Follow the garden’s footpaths at your own pace, pausing at works that catch your eye; keep the museum visit separate if you want indoor galleries.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor sculpture viewing among landscaped City Park paths.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden has over 90 sculptures, is open daily, and has free admission.
cards.source_title: Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are daily, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. in summer and 10 a.m.–5 p.m. in winter; verify before travel.

cards.title: Add NOMA only if you want indoor galleries
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · City Park
cards.notes: Decide after the sculpture garden whether an indoor museum visit fits your budget and energy, then check the day’s gallery and admission details.
cards.short_summary: A nearby museum option that can extend a City Park outing.
cards.evidence_claim: NOMA’s FAQ lists university-student general admission and states that the adjacent Besthoff Sculpture Garden is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: FAQs - New Orleans Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum’s FAQ lists general admission for university students with ID; check current ticketing, exhibitions, and hours before visiting.
